Here are some words that can describe atheists:

1. Skeptical
2. Rational
3. Intellectual
4. Independent-minded
5. Open-minded
6. Critical
7. Logical
8. Empirical
9. Skeptic
10. Non-theistic
11. Agnostic (though agnostics are not necessarily atheists)
12. Free-thinker
13. Skeptical of supernatural claims
14. Emphasizes evidence and reason
15. Often critical of organized religion
